Win your case ASAP

Reads a complaint and ranks the theories that could end the case, by how early you can file them.

Draft analysis for attorney review. It is not legal advice and not a filing. Deadlines are computed on this page from the service date, assume personal service, roll forward past weekends and major court holidays, and must be confirmed against the current rules and the court's calendar before anything is docketed. Every quoted passage is checked word for word against the documents on the right; a red reference means the quote was not found. Demo matters are invented; the replay is built from a public case summary.
